title: YourWarden
description: YourWarden: Customize Minecraft's Warden attributes easily.
body: YourWarden is a Minecraft Forge mod that introduces a highly configurable variant of the Warden, allowing players to tweak its attributes through an intuitive in-game interface. This mod enhances gameplay flexibility by letting users customize key combat and movement properties of the Warden, creating unique challenges or adjusted difficulty levels tailored to their preferences.
